verdicts.reason: Both break the product badge. The cream circle behind the jar is cut off in the bottom-left corner, so the jar sits outline-only on the orange and almost disappears. Both also put a small left-aligned headline over centered content and leave large dead gaps. A at least keeps NEW and Try It stacked together on the center axis. B pushes NEW below the CTA, off-axis to the left and floating, and leaves an even emptier top band.
